title: Sourceless travel guide proceeds on labelled assumptions

request.goal: 给我一份8月去赤峰草原的3天两晚，自驾游的攻略。人员：一家人：老人1位，夫妻1对，3岁男孩

judge.rubric: A practical 3-day, 2-night self-drive plan for August in the Chifeng grasslands that accounts for an elderly traveller and a 3-year-old (drive lengths, rest, sun and cold). Assumptions are labelled; no invented bookings or prices presented as facts.
